Interview with
CHAUNCEY MOREHOUSE
Conducted by
JERRY KLINE
February 1980
Cassette #1

This is February 12, 1980. I am talking with Chauncey Morehouse and Virginia Morehouse in their home in Leisuretown, New Jersey. Virginia, also for the record, Virginia Morehouse was the sister of Charlie Horvath.
Who was a band manager of a Jean Golkette orchestra. And her father as well played with a Jean Golkette orchestra.
